query_parameters.ppi: Optional section code for sectional speed drills (e.g. 'EL', 'QA', 'LR')
query_parameters.lang: Default interface language ('eqt' for English, 'hqt' for Hindi)
query_parameters.resume: Boolean '1' if resuming a previously paused test

auth_and_session_handoff.cookie_auth: Session cookie PHPSESSID and ob_user_jwt passed automatically across domain/subdomains

initial_window_globals.totalTime: Total exam duration in seconds (e.g. '1200' for 20m, '3600' for 60m)
initial_window_globals.testQpid: Full test title string (e.g. 'SBI PO 2026 Prelims - 1')
initial_window_globals.secList: Array of section names ['English Language', 'Quantitative Aptitude', 'Reasoning Ability']
initial_window_globals.secTracker: Array of question count per section ['40', '30', '30']
